title: Best Akeneo alternatives in 2026
summary: Compare the best Akeneo alternatives for ecommerce PIM, with G2 ratings and what each platform does better, from brand-trained AI writing to retail syndication.
body_markdown:
The best Akeneo alternatives in 2026 are Hypotenuse AI, Salsify, Plytix, Syndigo, Inriver, Pimcore, Stibo Systems and Sales Layer. Each one is stronger at a different part of the job.


Teams compare them with Akeneo when choosing a PIM, and when the work around Akeneo starts to slow them down.


## What's happening to Akeneo Community Edition?


Akeneo Community Edition is still maintained. Akeneo's help center says it is[continuously supported](https://help.akeneo.com/akeneo-pim/akeneo-pim-product-support-dates) , and[new Community releases](https://github.com/akeneo/pim-community-dev/releases) shipped in 2026. What ended on 30 September 2026 is support for version 7.0.


Community Edition teams on 7.0 need to upgrade to a newer release to keep getting patches, and PaaS and on-premise customers on 7.0 need to migrate to Akeneo's SaaS. Either path is an upgrade project, which makes it a natural point to compare alternatives, especially for teams maintaining a self-hosted Community Edition with their own developers.


## How much does Akeneo cost?


Akeneo's[packages page](https://www.akeneo.com/compare-packages/) lists three SaaS packages. Growth starts at $0 a year, and Advanced and Premium are priced on a quote.


Supplier Data Manager, Shared Catalogs, Digital Showroom and the commerce platform apps are add-ons on every package. Community Edition is free to self-host.


The package is one part of the total. Implementation, integrations, AI usage and your team's time all add to it, which is how[PIM pricing](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/pim-pricing) works across most vendors.

## Top Akeneo alternatives for ecommerce PIM


Here are eight platforms worth comparing. Each entry covers what the platform is built for and where it stands out.


### Hypotenuse AI


Hypotenuse AI is an[AI-native PIM](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/features/ai-pim-solution) that gets the catalog work done for your team: missing attributes filled, copy written in your brand voice, products optimized to show up on Google and AI search, and every listing, images included, checked for accuracy and compliance before it goes live.


In an[Akeneo vs Hypotenuse AI](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/compare/akeneo-vs-hypotenuse-ai) comparison, these are the areas where Hypotenuse AI is stronger.


- **A bespoke AI model trained on your brand.** Akeneo writes from guidelines added to each prompt. Hypotenuse AI trains a model on your own product pages and brand guide, so the voice holds across every category.
- **Found on Google and AI search.** Akeneo reports on rankings once products are live. Hypotenuse AI writes each product's titles, descriptions, metadata and alt text for both Google and AI search, around the SEO keywords shoppers use, and optimizes them over time.
- **Images checked for every retailer.** Akeneo checks image size and format. Hypotenuse AI checks every image against each retailer's requirements, and generates the lifestyle and variation shots you're missing.
- **Built for large catalogs.** Hypotenuse AI works across thousands to millions of SKUs in bulk, and can start before your attribute list and category tree are finished, because its AI suggests the attributes and categories each product type needs.
- **Complete, accurate product data.** Hypotenuse AI fills missing attributes from the web, UPCs, product images and spec sheets, and classifies each product into your taxonomy.


Hypotenuse AI can replace Akeneo, with its team migrating the catalog across, or run alongside it. Teams keeping Akeneo, including a self-hosted Community Edition, can connect through the[Akeneo integration](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/integrations/akeneo) or import and export product files in CSV or Excel.


**Rated 4.7 on G2.**


### Salsify


Salsify is a cloud-native product experience management (PXM) platform used by brands and retailers. It combines PIM, syndication, GDSN, digital catalogs and digital shelf analytics in one platform.


- **Retailer syndication.** Content is checked against each retailer's requirements before it is sent across the PXM Network.
- **GDSN data pool.** Salsify runs a certified GDSN data pool for retailers that require it.
- **Supplier onboarding.** Supplier Experience Management checks incoming supplier content against your schema and validation rules, with automated feedback to suppliers.
- **Intelligence Suite.** AI pulls content from packaging, nutrition labels and spec sheets, and translates product content into other languages.
- **PIM and DAM with no-code workflows.** Product data and assets sit together, with a no-code workflow builder for review and approval.


**Rated 4.4 on G2.**


### Plytix


Plytix is a PIM and DAM platform built for growing brands. It offers a free Standard plan, and every plan includes unlimited users.


- **PIM and DAM together.** Product data and digital assets sit in one platform, with assets linked to products.
- **Channel templates.** More than 350 prebuilt templates prepare feeds for retailers and marketplaces, with direct publishing to Shopify and BigCommerce.
- **Bulk AI.** AI generates and translates product text for thousands of products at once, following your tone of voice.
- **Completeness and automations.** Completeness tracking per channel and market, with if/then automations that update and validate product data.
- **Brand Portals.** Branded e-catalogs let partners browse and export your product data.


**Rated 4.7 on G2.**


### Syndigo


Syndigo is a product content platform built around sending product data to retailers. It covers PIM, MDM, syndication and enhanced content, and its customers include both brands and retailers.


- **Retailer network.** Product data goes to more than 3,500 retailers, with each retailer's requirements built in.
- **Vendor onboarding.** Vendors register and submit product information, and get scorecards with feedback on what to fix.
- **AI agents.** Agents for content creation, enrichment, onboarding and syndication, with a conversational interface for business users.
- **Translation.** Product content is translated across markets inside the PIM.
- **Digital asset management.** Product data, digital assets and metadata are managed in one platform.


**Rated 4.4 on G2.**


### Inriver


Inriver is an enterprise PIM for manufacturers and brands that sell through large retailers.


- **Direct retailer syndication.** Syndicate Advance connects directly to retailers such as Home Depot, Walmart and Wayfair.
- **AI content onboarding.** Product data comes in from PDF, Excel, Word and upstream systems such as PLM and ERP, with AI-assisted field mapping.
- **Inspire AI.** AI agents generate and translate product content from the structured data in the PIM.
- **Brand Store.** A self-service portal where partners and distributors download product data and assets.
- **Digital Shelf Analytics and print.** Live retailer listings are checked against your source data, and product data flows into print catalogs and sales materials.


**Rated 4.2 on G2.**


### Pimcore


Pimcore is an open-source platform that combines PIM, MDM, DAM and CMS. The Community Edition is free, and Professional and Enterprise editions are annual subscriptions.


- **Flexible data model.** Products, variants and relationships can be modeled to fit complex catalogs, with support for standards such as ETIM, eCl@ss, GS1 and UNSPSC.
- **AI agents.** Chat agents in Pimcore Studio propose changes for a person to approve, alongside AI translation through providers such as DeepL.
- **DAM.** Assets in more than 200 file formats are managed with metadata and versioning.
- **Print and multichannel publishing.** Data goes out through APIs, file exports and Adobe InDesign for print.
- **Deployment choice.** Runs on your own servers or in the cloud.


**Rated 4.5 on G2.**


### Stibo Systems


Stibo Systems is an enterprise master data management vendor whose Product Experience Data Cloud covers PIM, supplier onboarding, syndication and data quality.


- **Supplier portal.** Suppliers submit product information against your requirements and are notified when updates are needed.
- **Retailer syndication.** Product data goes to destinations such as Amazon, Walmart, The Home Depot and Wayfair, plus GDSN data pools.
- **Translation.** AI translation runs inside the platform, with connectors to translation services such as Lionbridge and TransPerfect.
- **ProductGen AI.** AI writes titles and descriptions from structured attributes.
- **Digital asset management.** Images, videos and documents are managed alongside product records, with integrations for DAMs such as Bynder and Aprimo.


**Rated 4.3 on G2.**


### Sales Layer


Sales Layer is a PIM for B2B and B2C companies, with catalog publishing built in.


- **Instant catalogs and PDF export.** Product data turns into digital catalogs and PDF exports without a separate design tool.
- **AI agents.** Agents translate content and write descriptions and bullet points.
- **Quality scores.** A real-time quality score shows gaps by product, language, channel or taxonomy.
- **Marketplace and retailer connectors.** Prebuilt connectors cover channels such as Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot and Target.
- **Pricing.** Quote-based tiers with user and SKU limits, and AI agents run on prepaid credits.


**Rated 4.6 on G2.**


## Choosing an Akeneo alternative


Start with why you're looking for alternatives. If the version 7.0 change is the trigger, shortlist the PIMs built for your main job: Salsify and Syndigo for retail syndication, Inriver and Stibo Systems for complex enterprise catalogs, Pimcore for an open-source build, and Plytix or Sales Layer for a lighter SaaS PIM.


If the bottleneck is the work around the PIM, such as filling attributes, writing on-brand copy at scale, producing images or getting products to show up on Google and AI search, Hypotenuse AI is built for that work, as your PIM or alongside Akeneo while you decide.
